Hi Emma —

Great conversation today. Quick post-call recap and proposed next steps to keep the Mutual Action Plan moving:

1) Milestone: Data handling & compliance checklist (this thread)
   - High-level asks from VitaCare: PHI handling, retention period for audit logs, SOC2 evidence, and redaction/PII handling guidance.
   - Target close for this milestone: proposed 2027-09-30 (can adjust based on legal/procurement needs).

2) Proposed owners (Redwood):
   - Compliance evidence & audit artifacts: Monica Patel
   - Deployment/security ops/keys: Marissa Cole
   - SLA / logging retention SLT: Rishi Malhotra

Attached is an initial MAP checklist I promised on the call (VAH-MAP-data-checklist_v1.xlsx). It contains proposed acceptance criteria and dependencies.

Ask for you: can you confirm whether PHI will be transmitted in plaintext to the inference endpoint or if VitaCare will tokenize/transform PHI before send? Also confirm the required minimum audit log retention (you mentioned multi-year during the call).

Proposed next touch: 30-minute sync next Wed (2027-08-25) to align on DPA language + procurement timeline. Let me know if that works and who from your team should join from procurement/security.

Thanks —

Thanks Sean —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from our side:

- PHI handling: we do not tokenize at source for all calls today. Some payloads will contain PHI fields (patient name, DOB, limited notes). We'd prefer Redwood to support a HIPAA BAA and to treat requests as PHI by default for this integration.
- Audit log retention: procurement is asking for 7 years retention for PHI-related audit trails. Is that feasible?
- Evidence: can you provide SOC 2 Type II and an architecture diagram showing network controls (VPC peering / egress restrictions)?

We'll attach our security questionnaire for your compliance team to review (attached). Also looping in Paul from procurement to coordinate contract language.

Emma Jones
Head of IT Security | VitaCare
emma.j@vitacare.com

Team — forwarding VitaCare's response. Key asks summarized and proposed internal action items:

VitaCare asks:
- Treat requests as PHI by default; Redwood to support HIPAA BAA
- 7-year retention for PHI audit logs
- SOC2 Type II report + architecture diagram showing VPC controls
- Confirmation on KMS control & whether customer-managed keys in their VPC are required

Internal proposed owners/next steps:
- Monica: lead compliance evidence (collect SOC2 report, SOC2 bridge letter if needed, and answer questionnaire). Target: deliver to VitaCare security by 2027-08-24.
- Marissa: document deployment options for VitaCare (hosted with VPC peering, dedicated, and private on-prem/offline), and confirm KMS integration approach. Action: produce architecture diagram and KMS options by 2027-08-20.
- Rishi: confirm logging retention mechanics (how we can retain logs for 7 years, export mechanics, cost implications) and propose SLOs/SLAs for retention and access. Action: provide proposal by 2027-08-23.
- Legal: we need DPA/BAA template — request legal to draft/redline; Sean to flag procurement ask.

Dependencies noted:
- Procurement requires formal quote tied to an MRC/committed capacity number before final DPA/BAA negotiation.
- Technical feasibility of 7-year log retention may require external cold storage (S3 Glacier) and an export workflow — include cost estimate.

I'll start pulling the SOC2 package and respond to the questionnaire. Sean — recommend we share a lightly-redlined MAP (Milestones + owners + acceptance criteria) back to VitaCare before the Wed touch.

--
Monica Patel
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 14:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MA Plan: Data protection checklist & owners

Emma / Paul —

Thanks for the fast reply and for sending the questionnaire. We've updated the MAP draft with milestone acceptance criteria and owners (attached MAPlan_v2.xlsx). Below is an inline summary of the data-handling milestone and the acceptance criteria we propose — please confirm or flag edits.

DATA HANDLING MILESTONE (proposed)
- Target close: 2027-09-30
- Acceptance criteria:
  * PHI handling: System will be configured so VitaCare's traffic is treated as PHI; BAAs supported and can be executed prior to go-live.
  * Encryption: In-transit TLS 1.2+; at-rest encryption using customer-managed KMS keys for any persisted artifacts.
  * Logging/audit trails: Per-request audit logging (request metadata, requestor ID, timestamp, model variant). Retention configurable; default export option for 7-year retention to VitaCare-managed storage (S3 Glacier recommended).
  * Access controls: Role-based access controls for any logs or exported datasets; audit trail on admin access.
  * PII redaction: We will provide guidance and a configurable redaction preprocessor; VitaCare may elect to tokenize at client-side.

- Dependencies:
  * Legal signoff on DPA/BAA
  * Procurement to provide committed capacity numbers for pricing
  * VitaCare to confirm whether tokenization will be done client-side or by Redwood transform layer

Next steps:
- Monica to share SOC2 artifacts by 2027-08-24 (Monica)
- Marissa to deliver deployment diagram + KMS options by 2027-08-20 (Marissa)
- Rishi to propose retention/export cost and mechanics by 2027-08-23 (Rishi)
- Sean to schedule the Wed 8/25 30-minute DPA + procurement touch (will provide meeting invite)

If these acceptance criteria look good I can attach MAPlan_v2.xlsx and mark the milestone in the MAP as owner-assigned.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: MAPlan_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — this is exactly the level of detail we need. A couple quick notes:

- 7-year retention is a firm procurement ask for PHI-related audit trails. We expect Redwood to provide export or managed retention options; cold storage is fine as long as retrieval is possible within agreed SLAs.
- Procurement will need a formal quote (capacity & cost) to move forward on the DPA/BAA. Paul, can you confirm the procurement timeline?
- HIPAA BAA: this is non-negotiable for VitaCare for PHI. Happy to review Redwood's standard BAA.

We can do the 30-minute sync on Wed 2027-08-25 at 11:00am ET. I will invite procurement and our legal lead.
